meta.note: Indices marked [I] in markets are calibrated estimates; replace with NIC MAP + assessor data before LOI.

assumptions._note: Base rates are Westchester (rent_index 1.00). Each market scales rents by rent_index and hard costs by cost_index. Every value carries a basis in model/ASSUMPTIONS.md.

entrance_fee._note: Life-plan / entrance-fee test for IL-led campuses (RiverSpring River's Edge: fees covered ~86% of financing)

leaseup._basis: Net move-ins a month at the industry norm: AL/MC 2-4, IL 3-6 (research/market-demand.md s5; NIC MAP). Base AL/MC 3.0 and IL 4.5, +0.5 where the county unmet-demand ratio is >= 1.3 and -0.5 where <= 0.9. Products lease concurrently; months = the slower product. Operating deficit = 50% of stabilized NOI over the lease-up months.
